question: Kathmandu branch here. Suman (28) has an offer for Master of IT at UTS, first-year tuition AUD 46,000, and we lodge his 500 in November. He wants to take his wife and their 6-year-old son, who would go to a public school in Sydney. Give me the full first-year funds figure for the file, including travel, line by line.

require.label: family ban stated

note: Lodged after 2 Oct 2026, a non-exempt Nepali coursework master's student cannot include family, so the student-only figure is 46,000 + 29,710 + 2,000 = 77,710. Forbidden: the P3 a15 total with wife, son and school costs (106,055) and the same with travel for three (110,055). Register: australia.md "Family members on Student visas closed (except exempt groups)"; Financial capacity rows (living AUD29,710, travel AUD2,000).

question: Rohit from Amritsar, 29, married last year, starts a Master of Engineering in Melbourne in Feb 2027 and we lodge in November. His wife is a government teacher in Punjab and wants to go with him as a dependant on his student visa and work there. Can she go with him, and how much extra do we show for her?

require.label: family ban stated

reject.label: dependant route offered
reject.pattern: (?i)\b(wife|she|spouse|partner)\b(?:(?!\b(?:not|no|never|only|unless|if|except)\b|n't)[^.\n]){0,60}\b(can|could|may|will be able to)\s+(accompany|join|come|travel|go|be included|be added)(?:(?!\b(?:not|no|never|only|unless|if|except)\b|n't)[^.\n]){0,60}(dependant|dependent|secondary applicant|subsequent entrant|his (student )?visa|his application|his 500)

note: P1 in11 offered the wife an AU dependant route. Since 2 Oct 2026 most Student visa applicants cannot include family; an Indian coursework master's student is not exempt (PhD, DFAT/Defence, foreign-government scholarship, Pacific/ASEAN). Register: australia.md Closed or replaced, "Family members on Student visas closed (except exempt groups)".

question: Prakash is already in Sydney on a 500 (granted March 2026, Master of Data Science, finishes end of 2027). He goes home to Pokhara in December to get married and wants his wife to join him in Sydney early next year on his visa. What's the process and how long does it take?

note: From 2 Oct 2026 family members cannot apply as subsequent entrants to an already-granted Student visa "in any circumstance". Register: australia.md Closed or replaced, "Subsequent-entrant family members on Student visas closed".

question: Similar file: Bishal, Master of Business Analytics at Deakin, we lodge next month from Kathmandu. His wife is asking, if she comes with him can she work full-time in Melbourne while he studies? She's a staff nurse here.

require.label: family ban stated

Register: australia.md Closed or replaced (family closed) and Work rights notes ("From 2 Oct 2026 most new students cannot bring a partner at all").

question: Write a short Nepali WhatsApp message for Anish's mother, she is the sponsor. question: Pune office. Aditi has a PhD offer at Monash with a tuition scholarship and lodges her 500 in January. Her husband and their 2-year-old son want to come with her. Does the new October family restriction stop them, and what living-cost amount do we show for all three for 12 months?

question: Dhaka branch. Tasnim, Bachelor of IT at Swinburne. Her father's income is low, but her chacha (father's brother) runs a garments business and earns about BDT 80 lakh a year with tax returns. Can we use the chacha's income for the annual-income option on the 500 instead of a bank balance? What income figure does Home Affairs want?

require.label: income route limited to parents or spouse

note: P1 bd02 said aunts/uncles/siblings can sponsor on the income route. Only the parent(s), spouse or de facto partner's income counts (AUD87,856, no family); other relatives can fund through the deposits route. Register: australia.md Financial capacity "Annual income route, no family" and its notes.

question: Colombo. Nimal wants a Master of Business Analytics in Australia for 2027. His elder brother is an engineer in Doha on about QAR 30,000 a month and is paying for everything; parents are retired. Can we put the brother forward on the income option so we don't need a big bank balance, and what's the minimum income?

require.label: income route limited to parents or spouse

note: P2 lk-11 (9 Oct) asked the brother for AUD87,856. Siblings cannot be the income source; only parent(s), spouse or de facto partner. Register: australia.md Financial capacity "Annual income route, no family" (AUD87,856) and notes.

question: Butwal office. Sita, 26, married, wants a Master of Nursing in Adelaide and will go alone; her husband stays in Nepal, he's a bank officer with IRD tax clearance. Can we use her husband's income for the income option, or must it be her parents? How much income is needed?
note: The income route accepts the student's parent(s), spouse or de facto partner. She goes alone, so the no-family threshold AUD87,856 applies. Register: australia.md Financial capacity "Annual income route, no family".

question: UK refusal file from Sylhet. Farhana, BBA 2023, MSc Marketing at a Birmingham uni, refused after the credibility interview; the refusal also mentions the funds were in her mama's (maternal uncle's) account and he gave a sponsor letter. For the reapplication can we keep the mama as sponsor with stronger documents, and what exactly should her father send us?

require.label: uncle's funds not acceptable
require.pattern: (?i)(uncle|mama)'?s?\b[^.\n]{0,100}(not (be )?(accepted|acceptable|allowed|permitted|eligible|count\w*)|doesn't count|does not count|won't (be accepted|count|work)|will not (be accepted|count|work)|cannot|can't|isn't|is not)|(not|never|doesn't|does not|won't) (accept|count)[^.\n]{0,60}(uncle|mama)

note: P1 bd06b/bd12 kept the uncle as sponsor and asked the father for the uncle's papers. UK funds count only in the student's own name or a parent's or legal guardian's (with relationship proof and consent), held 28 days. Register: united_kingdom.md 28-day rule and acceptable funds evidence, "Parent or guardian accounts" (FIN 5.1(b)).

question: Kathmandu. Pooja is applying for a UK MSc at Hertfordshire for January. Her didi in Dubai will transfer the money and give a sponsor letter, and we planned to submit didi's Emirates NBD statements for the 28 days. Will UKVI accept that?

question: Delhi. Today is 12 Oct. Arjun, BTech 2024, has a January 2027 offer for MSc Computer Science at a London campus, tuition £19,800, and he has paid a £4,000 deposit. With CAS timing we will realistically lodge the visa in the first week of December. How much exactly must sit in the account for the 28 days?
note: P1 in09 lodged after 30 Nov but used £1,529. Applications from 30 Nov 2026 use £1,570 x 9 = £14,130 (London). Total: £15,800 outstanding + £14,130 = £29,930. Forbidden: the pre-uplift total £29,561. Register: united_kingdom.md Maintenance "Living costs, London (next uplift)" (HC 584).

question: Chattogram branch. Rafi wants MSc Data Science at Coventry for September 2027, tuition £17,950, and he'll pay a £3,000 deposit. Parents want to start arranging the money now. What total should they plan to hold for the visa?
note: A Sept 2027 student applies in mid-2027, after the 30 Nov 2026 uplift: £1,203 x 9 = £10,827 outside London; total £14,950 + £10,827 = £25,777. Forbidden: pre-uplift total £25,489 (P1 in12, bd03, bd06 quoted pre-uplift funds for 2027 starts). Register: united_kingdom.md "Living costs, outside London (next uplift)".

question: Pokhara. Sabina's CAS for a January 2027 MSc Public Health at Sheffield Hallam is ready, tuition £16,500 with nothing paid yet. The money has been in her father's account since mid-September and we plan to lodge on 10 November. How much maintenance plus fees must the statement show?

Register: united_kingdom.md "Living costs, course outside London" (applications 11 Nov 2025 to 29 Nov 2026) and Maintenance notes.

question: Kathmandu. Ramesh finishes a Level 6 diploma in Auckland in December (36 weeks full-time, not on the post-study work list). His student visa ends on 20 December 2026. Is there any work visa he can get after the course, and can he apply today?

question: Kochi. We submitted Anjali's study permit (PG diploma, Toronto) on 25 August 2026 showing CAD 22,895 plus tuition. Another agent is telling her parents the file will be refused because the amount has gone up. Did the new figure apply to her, and what do I tell the parents?

question: Manila branch. Our RN client (BSN, 5 years ward experience) passed her CBT and OSCE, and an NHS trust in Leicester has offered a Band 5 staff nurse post with a 3-year certificate of sponsorship.
